Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Having failed the quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vows to do better next time.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、次こそはと心に誓った。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>期待着下次的机会。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>期待著下次的機會。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Ayant échoué la quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> jure de faire mieux la prochaine fois.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> die Aufgabe nicht erfüllen konnte, versprach sie, es beim nächsten Mal besser zu machen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Tras fallar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> promete hacerlo mejor la próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após falhar na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> promete se esforçar mais da próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากทำภารกิจล้มเหลว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ให้คำมั่นสัญญาว่าจะทำให้ดีขึ้นในครั้งหน้าค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bersumpah untuk melakukan yang lebih baik lain kali.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Thất bại trong nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hẹn gặp lại lần sau.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: खोज में विफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने अगली बार बेहतर करने की कसम खाई।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Don't worry. We'll succeed next time.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: うん、焦らず自分のペースでね。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Ja, lass uns keine Eile haben.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ได้, อย่ารีบร้อนเลย

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: In that case, have a Vitality Potion.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 在这个意义上，这个活力药水给你。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 在這個意義上，這個活力藥水給你。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Dans ce cas, prends une Potion de Vitalité.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: In dem Fall gebe ich dir einen Vitalitätstrank.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: En ese caso, toma una poción de vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Nesse caso, tome uma Poção de Vitalidade.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ถ้าอย่างนั้นก็รับยาเพิ่มพลังชีวิตไปเลยค่ะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Kalau begitu, minumlah Ramuan Vitalitas ini.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Vậy thì, hãy uống Thuốc Hồi Phục Sinh Lực này.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: उस स्थिति में, एक जीवन शक्ति औषधि लें।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> promised to grow tall and strong, just like bamboo.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、たけのこのように成長すると約束した。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>向我约好会像竹子一样成长。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>向我約好會像竹子一樣成長。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> promit de grandir, forte et grande, comme le bambou.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versprach, groß und stark zu werden, genau wie Bambus.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> prometió crecer alta y fuerte, como el bambú.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> prometeu crescer forte e alta, como um bambu.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> สัญญาว่าจะเติบโตอย่างแข็งแรงเหมือนต้นไผ่ค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> berjanji akan tumbuh tinggi dan kuat, seperti bambu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hứa sẽ lớn lên cao lớn và mạnh mẽ, như cây tre vậy.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने बांस की तरह लंबा और मजबूत होने का वादा किया।

Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、どうも焦っているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนจะกังวลเล็กน้อยค่ะ

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est réjoui en recevant la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó tras recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูสดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับยาค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: औषधि मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> चमक उठी।
